name: game
//: MUI and Emotion are peers, like React: the board needs them, and the app that renders it — online-frontend, offline-frontend — provides them. As peers they stay out of the backend's production install, which takes this package in as a workspace dependency (Dockerfile); listed in devDependencies they would not, since npm installs a workspace's devDependencies even under --omit=dev.

@mui/icons-material is imported by no board here. It stays declared for a year's private game whose board uses an icon, so the import resolves from a declared dependency rather than by npm hoisting common-frontend's copy — issue #432 is what that accident looks like when it breaks. Both apps that render a board declare it for the same reason.
